scientific_integrity: General theorem proved through an explicit rooted bounded-morphism diagram; small finite enumeration is a cross-check rather than proof. Priority remains subject to independent literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: Uniform bound on shortest directed reachability paths, finite nonempty Kripke frames, definability by possibly infinitely many basic modal formulas. Does not decide the unrestricted finite-frame question. The depth lower bound concerns characteristic rooted diagrams.
title: Bounded reachability gives a finite Goldblatt–Thomason theorem without the universal modality
